name: AUTOPILOT.OI Video Agent
description_html:
Post better TikToks, more often, with less work.

Turn Claude into your TikTok Video Agent in 10 minutes. Studies your niche, writes a week of scripts, plans every cut and caption for CapCut, writes the post, schedules it, and tells you what to double down on.

Inside: the full master prompt, 5 starter prompts, a step by step setup and your tracker. Works with Claude's free or paid plan.

Education only. Confirm TikTok's current rules and fees in the app. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic or TikTok.
